system.description:
Your Spirit Guide embodies the instinctive qualities of an animal or collection of animals.
It need not correspond to a literal animal that once lived. A wolf spirit might represent pack loyalty and pursuit rather than the soul of a particular wolf.
Specialist Skill Animal Lore
Spirit Boon – Wild Understanding: You may communicate with animals on a rudimentary level through posture, emotion, sound and spiritual intuition.
You gain a +2-class bonus to checks made to communicate with animals.
Manifestation – Beast Within: While Manifest Spirit is active:
• your Speed increases by 10 feet;
• you gain Scent as a tertiary sense; and
• you gain a +1-dodge bonus to DB.
Spectral claws, antlers, feathers, scales, eyes or other features of your Spirit Guide may become visible around your body.

Wild Understanding — +2 class is offered on Handle Animal checks with the book's wording. Beast Within is what Manifest Spirit applies.
